math_steps.explanation:
$$\begin{gathered}f\!\left(x\right)=\left(2 a + 4\right)x-5,\ x < 1\\\text{斜率}\ 2 a + 4>0\Rightarrow a\in \left(-2, +\infty\right)\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}f\!\left(x\right)=x^{2}-ax+\frac{a}{2},\ x \geq 1\\\text{开口向上，对称轴}\ x=\frac{a}{2}\\\text{严格递增的部分}:\ x\ge \frac{a}{2}\\\frac{a}{2}\le 1\Rightarrow a\in \left(-\infty, 2\right]\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: $x < 1$ 这一段

items.label: 两侧的值
items.math: \begin{gathered}\left(2 a + 4\right)x-5\ \text{在}\ x\to 1\ \text{时趋近}\ 2 a - 1\ (\text{取不到})\\f(1)=1 - \frac{a}{2}\end{gathered}

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}x < 1\ \text{段}:\ a\in \left(-2, +\infty\right)\\x \geq 1\ \text{段}:\ a\in \left(-\infty, 2\right]\\\text{分界点 }x=1:\ a\in \left(-\infty, \frac{4}{5}\right]\\\text{取交集}:\ a\in \left(-2, \frac{4}{5}\right]\end{gathered}$$
